mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.user_id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.nickname,''),u.username) nickname, u.phone, g.record_date, g.node_code, g.glucose_value, g.source_type, g.remark, g.recorded_at, COALESCE(h.status,'PENDING') status, h.note, COALESCE(h.version,0) version, h.handled_by, h.handled_at, h.user_reply, h.replied_at FROM glucose_record g JOIN user_account u ON u.id = g.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON p.user_id = g.user_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN gp_glucose_alert_case h ON h.record_id = g.id AND h.glucose_value = g.glucose_value AND h.recorded_at = g.recorded_at WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.glucose_value > 0 AND g.glucose_value < 40 AND g.node_code IN ('before_breakfast','after_breakfast','before_lunch', 'after_lunch','before_dinner','after_dinner') AND (g.glucose_value < 3.9 OR g.glucose_value >= 10 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gp_glucose_alert_case old WHERE old.record_id = g.id))
